cells.title: Open and land a feature with one verb each, and route without placeholder flags
cells.action: `bee feature start --feature <slug> --class <c> --lane <l> [--flags <a,b>] --files <n>` leaves the same state the separate verbs leave today: a granted feature worktree, a lane record for the feature, and the recorded route, and prints the worktree path and the instruction line `bee worktree new` prints. `bee feature finish --feature <slug> --areas <a,b>` runs worktree merge, then the scribing stamp, then close, stops at the first refusal with that verb's own message, and never approves a gate or the uat door. `bee route --set` (and `bee state route --set`) accepts a route with no risk flags when --flags is omitted or empty, recording flags=0. Each step's refusal passes through unchanged. Item 1 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-1`.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- feature_group route

truths: bee feature start leaves a worktree, a lane record and the route, equal to the separate verbs
bee feature finish runs merge, scribing stamp and close in order and stops at the first refusal with its message
bee route --set with no --flags or empty --flags records flags=0
bee feature --help lists start and finish

artifacts.substantive: Open and land a feature with one verb each, and route without placeholder flags

cells.title: bee herding run caps a cell the worker finished but did not cap
cells.action: When a herding worker reports outcome done for a cell with a commit and a proof line whose result is green, `bee herding run` caps the cell through the same finish door `bee cells finish --from-job` uses, and its output says it capped. A red or missing proof, no commit, or a refusal from finish leaves today's message naming the settle command, and the run exit code tells the two apart. A worker that capped itself is unchanged. Item 2 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-2`.

truths: a done result with a commit and a green proof is capped by herding run itself
a red or missing proof or no commit leaves the cell uncapped with the settle command named
an already-capped cell is not capped twice

artifacts.substantive: bee herding run caps a cell the worker finished but did not cap

cells.title: dispatch prepare works after a vendored prompt changes, with no hand rebuild
cells.action: Today `bee dispatch prepare` refuses with prompt skew when packages/bee/prompts/*.md differs from the template compiled into the binary, and the fix is a hand rebuild and copy of .bee/bin/bee. After this cell, the flow that lands a prompt change (bee dev regen, or the merge that carries it) leaves a state where dispatch prepare renders the on-disk prompt it would render after a fresh build, with no manual step; the skew refusal stays for a binary that truly cannot render the on-disk prompt. Choose the mechanism; name it in your report. Keep tests out of verbs/drivers/tests.rs, which cells aef-5 and aef-6 edit. Item 3 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-3`.

truths: after a prompt source change lands through the normal flow, dispatch prepare succeeds with no hand rebuild
the rendered prompt equals the on-disk prompt source
a binary that cannot render the on-disk prompt still refuses with prompt skew

artifacts.substantive: dispatch prepare works after a vendored prompt changes, with no hand rebuild

cells.title: A leader goal-check miss is a gap verdict that reopens the cell
cells.action: `bee cells leader-check --id <id> --verdict gap --file <payload>` records the gap and returns the capped cell to open for rework, with the gap answers as the reopen reason, so the next dispatch's Prior rounds shows them. A gap payload names each missing requirement; an artifact path is not required for a gap answer. The ok verdict is unchanged. The goal-check step in skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md tells the leader to record a miss this way. bee report outcomes then counts the miss in the leader check row with no change of its own. Item 4 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-4`.

truths: leader-check --verdict gap reopens a capped cell with the gap answers as the reason
a gap answer needs no existing artifact path
leader-check --verdict ok behaves as before
swarming-reference.md goal-check step records a miss with leader-check --verdict gap

artifacts.substantive: A leader goal-check miss is a gap verdict that reopens the cell

cells.title: The Prior rounds digest carries a block or reopen reason in full
cells.action: The Prior rounds block of a cell dispatch prompt today cuts a block or reopen reason after about 150 chars, so a re-dispatched worker loses the fix the leader wrote. After this cell, block and reopen reasons appear in full; other history kinds keep their current shape; the block as a whole still has a size bound, and when that bound cuts, the newest round is kept whole and the cut is marked. Item 5 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-5`.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- prior_rounds prepare

truths: a 600-char block reason reaches the prompt in full
a 600-char reopen reason reaches the prompt in full
the digest still has a total bound that keeps the newest round whole and marks a cut

cells.title: Trim the worker cell prompt to what the skill does not already carry
cells.action: The cell prompt rendered by `bee dispatch prepare --kind cell` repeats rules the bee-swarming Execute section already gives the worker. After this cell the prompt is materially shorter, and a worker still meets in it, or in a skill the prompt tells it to load, every contract it must keep: identity and location, the inlined cell, the three-part brief and the better-route line, the status tokens, the Result form fields and the closed tests result set, the finish command, and the no-comment rule. Report the before and after line counts. Update the golden prompt expectations to the new text only. Item 6 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-6`.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- drivers prompts

truths: the rendered cell prompt is materially shorter than before, with line counts reported
every listed contract is in the prompt or in a skill the prompt names
the herding variant still holds no bee command

cells.title: Flush the capture queue and settle the unapplied promote proposals
cells.action: Load bee-capturing. Drain the pending capture stubs (22 at plan time) oldest first into their area concepts, and for each unapplied promote proposal (20 at plan time) either apply what belongs in docs/knowledge or record why not, then mark it complete with bee deferred-queue complete --kind promote --feature <f>. A stub or proposal that is already reflected in a concept is recorded as such, never duplicated. Report counts applied, skipped with reason, and left. Item 7 of D1. Parallel cells share this worktree: stage and commit only your own paths by name. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: aef-7`.

truths: the capture queue holds no pending stub, or each one left is named with its reason
every promote proposal is applied or recorded as skipped, and marked complete
no concept gains a near-duplicate of an entry it already holds

artifacts.substantive: Flush the capture queue and settle the unapplied promote proposals

key_links: bee status --json reports the capture queue and promote debt drained
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Never hand-edit .bee state; use the bee CLI
